skills.description: Multi-format document reader and Q&A markdown generator. This skill reads Word (.docx), PDF (.pdf), PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx), text files (.txt/.md/.csv/.json etc.), and image files (.png/.jpg etc.), extracts key information, and generates a structured summary plus Q&A markdown document. This skill should be used when the user wants to: extract key information from one or more documents; generate study notes or Q&A cards from documents; summarize and create question-answer pairs from reports, papers, manuals, contracts, or any text-heavy files; batch process multiple documents into a unified Q&A knowledge base. Trigger phrases include: 提取文档信息, 生成问答, 文档摘要问答, 从文件提取要点, 读文档生成Q&A, document to Q&A, extract info from files, summarize document as questions.
